name: Cinderling
desc: A coal that learned to hate.

name: Ashrunner
desc: Fast ash-hounds that hunt in pairs.

name: Clinker
desc: Skittering slag. There are always more.

name: Emberwisp
desc: Erratic sparks that burst when snuffed.

name: Slagspitter
behavior: Lobber(range: 11.0, windup: 1.1, radius: 1.4, damage: 18.0, cooldown: 3.2, keep_distance: 7.0)
desc: Lobs molten slag where you are about to be.

name: Kindlejack
desc: Runs at you. Then it is you who runs.

name: Anvil Brute
behavior: Charger(range: 9.0, windup: 0.9, speed: 13.0, duration: 0.55, cooldown: 3.5, damage: 34.0, width: 1.4)
desc: Plated in anvil-iron. Kinetic rounds glance off until the plates crack.

name: Forge Warden
desc: Wraps nearby Unmade in forge-shields. Kill it first.

name: Molten Hexer
behavior: Caster(range: 13.0, windup: 1.2, width: 1.2, length: 14.0, damage: 36.0, cooldown: 3.8, keep_distance: 9.0)
desc: Channels molten beams across the arena.

name: The Bellows
desc: A furnace-lung the size of a house. It breathes fire and cinderlings.

name: The Slag King
desc: A living foundry colossus crowned in cooling slag.

name: Lampcap
desc: A mushroom with a grudge and a lantern for a head.

name: Bramblehound
desc: The temple's hedges grew teeth. Now they hunt in pairs.

name: Rotmite
desc: Beetles fat on temple rot. Crush one and forty come to the funeral.

name: Glimmermoth
desc: Bioluminescent moths that burst into glowing spores when swatted.

name: Spore Censer
behavior: Lobber(range: 11.5, windup: 1.1, radius: 1.6, damage: 19.0, cooldown: 3.3, keep_distance: 7.5)
desc: A temple censer that still swings. The incense is spores now.

name: Bloatbulb
desc: Waddles close, swells up and bursts. Be somewhere else.

name: Barkhide Aurochs
behavior: Charger(range: 9.5, windup: 0.95, speed: 13.5, duration: 0.6, cooldown: 3.5, damage: 36.0, width: 1.5)
desc: Grazed the temple lawns for a thousand years and grew bark. Plague seeps off until the bark splits; fire bites deep.

name: Lichen Abbot
desc: Still tends the dead god's garden, growing living bark over nearby Unmade. Prune it first.

name: Rot Cantor
behavior: Caster(range: 13.5, windup: 1.2, width: 1.3, length: 15.0, damage: 38.0, cooldown: 3.8, keep_distance: 9.0)
desc: A lesser voice of the Choir. Its hymn is a beam of rot.

name: The Gullet Bloom
desc: A carnivorous flower grown fat on the altar's offerings. It is still hungry.

name: Choir of Rot
desc: Three plague-singers grown from one rotten body, still singing their dead god's last hymn. They never agree on the harmony, only on you.

name: Cogling
desc: A stray cog still turning toward something to grind.

name: Gloamhound
desc: Twilight hounds that arrive half a second before they leave.

name: Ticker
desc: Pocket-watch mites. Hear one tick and there are forty.

name: Starmote
desc: Drifting star-dust that flares when snuffed.

name: Stargazer
behavior: Caster(range: 11.0, windup: 1.0, width: 0.7, length: 12.0, damage: 16.0, cooldown: 4.2, keep_distance: 8.0)
desc: A telescope that learned to look back. It focuses starlight into a line.

name: Knellbell
desc: It tolls once when it sees you. Do not be there for the second toll.

name: Nightglass Lancer
behavior: Charger(range: 10.5, windup: 0.9, speed: 15.0, duration: 0.6, cooldown: 3.3, damage: 38.0, width: 1.4)
desc: A clockwork knight plated in nightglass that drinks light. Radiant fire glances off until the plates crack.

name: Horologist
desc: Winds nearby Unmade tight in brass shields, tick by tick. Stop the clock first.

name: Comet Sling
behavior: Lobber(range: 14.0, windup: 1.3, radius: 2.4, damage: 40.0, cooldown: 3.8, keep_distance: 10.0)
desc: Walks on six clock-hands and hurls the broken sky at you. Storm shorts its springs.

name: The Gnomon
desc: A sundial blade the height of a tower. It cuts along its own shadow.

name: Aeon's Remnant
desc: What is left of Aeon, god of Time: a clockwork titan still striking the hour the gods died.

name: Fractling
desc: A splinter of broken geometry. It has one angle and it is sharp.

name: Wronghound
desc: A hound with its legs attached in the wrong order. Somehow faster.

name: Nullmite
desc: Motes of nothing. Crush them before they add up to something.

name: Paradox
desc: Exists and does not. Stops existing loudly.

name: Collapsar
behavior: Lobber(range: 12.0, windup: 1.1, radius: 1.7, damage: 22.0, cooldown: 3.2, keep_distance: 8.0)
desc: Flings small collapsing stars at where you are about to stand.

name: Vector
behavior: Charger(range: 8.0, windup: 0.8, speed: 14.0, duration: 0.4, cooldown: 3.0, damage: 20.0, width: 0.9)
desc: Knows exactly one direction and commits to it completely.

name: Null Herald
desc: Walks toward you calmly announcing the end, plated in folded nothing that swallows Void. Kill it before it arrives.

name: Unwright
desc: Unbuilds the world and rebuilds it as shields around its kin.

name: Geometer
behavior: Caster(range: 15.0, windup: 1.2, width: 1.4, length: 18.0, damage: 44.0, cooldown: 3.6, keep_distance: 10.0)
desc: Draws straight lines through a world that has none left. Do not stand on them.

name: The Axiom
desc: The last law of a broken world. It insists.

name: The Last Titan
desc: The final shape the Unmaking wears: a titan of raw chaos that remembers every god it ate. Bring everyone.
